fields.value:
Winning Post lets the player take control of a stable of horse, breeding and training them for the ultimate goal, to win the French Grand Prix.

The player can hire breeders, trainers and jockeys and race in over 240 different races to earn more money to buy even better personnel and breed faster and stronger horses as well as keeping their horses healthy. Players can also bet on races as well.

The gameplay consists of choosing options before races, such as choosing which horses to train and what regiment they undertake, view stats, hire personnel and place bets. However the player has no controls over races and cannot participate and only view as a spectator.

fields.value: Winning Post 9 is a thoroughbred horse racing simulation game series from Koei Tecmo (originally Koei) debuting in 1993.

A new and updated version of Winning post 9, with a new elements such as marriage and descendant succession systems is back, improves bond commands, meeting new connections at events, establish a club, implementing future scenarios starting in 2021, allows to transfer save data from Winning Post 9, receive a special bonuses if you have to save data from Winning Post 8 on your system, and Noel Himeka added as a secretary.

The Winning Post series is an authentic horse racing simulation game in which players become owner breeders (horse owners and producers) and experience drama with horses and people living in the world of horse racing.

A horse-racing management sim focused on breeding, training, and racing to produce champion thoroughbreds. Players balance detailed pedigree and bloodline systems, training plans, and race tactics across seasonal competitions, with expanded race conditions, track variety, and deeper jockey/horse interactions.

A detailed management sports sim that blends deep pedigree mechanics with race-day tactics, letting players develop young horses from foal to superstar while balancing long-term breeding strategy and immediate racing decisions.
